memo: Re-push of dn1-1 (refused: 2 GPU sessions busy). Training + validation only, T4, no submit. The MMP line stopped: on the class-3 simulation with parents >= 0.5 Tanimoto removed, MMP generates the truth for 0.053 of molecules and the FP-guided multi-step walk 0.057. New component: formula-constrained de novo generation. Base (cited): the host's CASMI denovo tutorial notebook (inversion/casmi-denovo-tutorial-notebook; peak encoder + SMILES decoder, BPE, unconstrained sampling). Ours: atom-level tokens with decoding constrained by the molecular formula (no token past an element's count, EOS only when every heavy atom is placed, full formula with H must match), the formula as an encoder token, our fp2 peak transformer as the encoder, timsTOF spectra first. Novel condition: train structures with Tanimoto >= 0.5 to the 250 held-out NP structures are removed. Up to 8 epochs / 3 h, then 4 spectra x 48 samples per held-out molecule. Pass: truth generated >= 0.15 (MMP 0.057); also logs MRR@25 of the generated list alone, valid and formula-correct rates, best Tanimoto in the top 25.
message: dn1-1b: formula-constrained de novo generator, novel condition 0.5
